label: Counter
desc: A rolling-digit counter with plus/minus buttons that repeat while held; it is a keyboard-operable spinbutton (arrows, Page keys, Home/End).
use: Quantity, seat or stock pickers in a checkout or settings form.

label: Curved input
desc: A text field with arched edges whose typed text is echoed along an arc above it; a real labelled input underneath.
use: A playful name, search or promo-code field in a hero or onboarding step.

label: Elastic slider
desc: A slider whose track is a string: dragging pulls it toward the pointer and it springs back with a wobble; full slider semantics.
use: Volume, intensity or price controls where tactile feedback is welcome.

label: Fluid glass
desc: A draggable glass lens that magnifies and refracts the scene behind it, with an edge displacement map and a slight colour split.
use: Over a hero image, product shot or chart to inspect detail; give it static markup as children.

label: Glass icons
desc: A row of frosted-glass icon tiles on tilted colour cards; hover or focus fans the card out and shows the label.
use: Feature shortcuts, app launchers or a compact link row over a colourful backdrop.

label: Lanyard
desc: A name badge hanging on a strap with verlet rope physics; drag the badge to swing it or push it with the arrow keys.
use: Team, speaker or event pages; fills its parent, which should be at least 200px tall.

label: Magic bento
desc: A bento grid of cards with a pointer spotlight that lights card borders as it passes and a gentle tilt on the hovered card.
use: Feature overviews on a landing page; pass your own cells with title, body, icon and size.

label: Model viewer
desc: A tiny 3D viewer for shapes built in code (cube, gem, low-poly rock) with drag-to-orbit, wheel and keyboard orbit and zoom.
use: Product or brand 3D previews where model files are overkill (fills its parent).

label: Morph slider
desc: A slider whose thumb and large preview morph through circle, square, diamond and star as the value changes.
use: Shape, roundness or style pickers in a theme or editor panel.

label: Option wheel
desc: A rotary selector: drag around the dial, scroll, click a dot or use the arrows; exposed as a radio group.
use: Picking one of 3-8 modes or presets, such as lighting or a time of day.

label: Card stack
desc: A pile of cards: drag, flick or click the top card to send it to the back; arrows and buttons do the same.
use: Tips, testimonials or onboarding steps in a small space.
